summary: Main UI render dispatcher. Reads the stored text pointer (this+0xB0, defaulting to byte_5EA438) and, when the string-table flag at this+0xE8 is set, resolves it through BinarySearchInStringTable into the shared buffer byte_5EC4CC before copying into a local buffer; otherwise copies it directly. Derives the alignment mode at this+0xE0 (1 left / 2 center / 3 right) from the first character of the alignment string at this+0xB8 via sub_589A35. Reads the render box from this+0x4/0x8/0xC/0x10, measures the text with TextRenderToSurface, and handles overflow: when the max-width limit this+0xE4 is <= 0 it re-centers the text within the box (CRTFtol rounding, alignment-aware), and when the limit is positive it truncates trailing characters until the text fits. Finally dispatches the actual draw by alignment mode (BitmapDraw / BitmapDrawWithAlpha / BitmapDraw_81f0) and writes the final rect to the four out-parameters. Called by UIRenderDispatchWrapper (0x488F40) and ConditionalRenderingCall (0x48D6F0). Returns 0 on success.
